Baking better sourdough in a home oven

By Jonah Bell on 12 September 2026 · 8 min read

For two years my loaves came out flat and pale. Then I changed three things, and last week's bake had the open crumb I had been chasing. Here is exactly what worked.

1. Steam matters more than heat

A home oven vents steam straight away. I preheat a Dutch oven at 250°C for a full hour, then bake covered for 20 minutes:

  1. Heat the pot, lid on, for 60 minutes
  2. Load the loaf on baking paper and cover at once
  3. Uncover after 20 minutes and finish for 15 to 20

2. Score with confidence

One firm cut at a shallow angle, about a centimetre deep. Hesitation drags the dough.

The full schedule

TimeStep
8:00 amMix flour, water and starter
12:00 pmShape and refrigerate
7:00 amBake from cold

If you only change one thing, make it the covered bake. My starter guide covers the beginning.
